label: ISS cabin
description: Sea-level-equivalent air with forced ventilation in microgravity.

source.label: NASA OCHMO ECLSS technical brief (NASA-STD-3001)
source.detail: ISS cabin nominal about 14.7 psi (101.4 kPa), about 21% O2

label: Lunar exploration atmosphere
description: Reduced pressure and enriched oxygen, as proposed for exploration habitats.

source.label: Spacecraft Fire Safety Demonstration (Saffire) status paper, NTRS 20170000230
source.detail: Exploration atmosphere of 34% O2 at 8.2 psi, page 7

label: Staged-decompression cabin (10.2 psi)
description: Reduced pressure and enriched oxygen, as flown on Space Shuttle missions before spacewalks. A candidate for long transit vehicles.

source.label: Effects of the 8 psia / 32% O2 Atmosphere on the Human in the Spaceflight Environment, NTRS 20130013505
source.detail: Staged decompression atmosphere of 10.2 psia / 26.5% O2, used on 34 shuttle missions. Its use for a transit vehicle is the team's assumption.

source.label: Designing an Exploration Atmosphere Prebreathe Protocol, NTRS 20140012830
source.detail: Extravehicular activities performed at 4.3 psia. The 100% O2 value is the team's entry for a pure-oxygen suit.
